items.title: Forget Chasing Double-Digit Yields. These 5 Dividend Stocks Offer Something Better
items.summary: A double-digit yield often means the market expects a cut. Five dividend payers from real estate, lending, pipelines, medicine and snacks pass a tougher test, and one of them covers its payout nearly twice over.

items.summary: A monthly paycheck only works if the cash behind it holds up. We tested four income payers against a 137-raise champion, and one of them hides a weakness that retirees on fixed bills should see before they buy.

items.title: Realty Income Stock And Other Tax Efficient Dividend Picks For US Income Investors
items.summary: U.S. debt just passed US$40b and talk of new wealth and asset taxes is no longer a fringe idea; it is in the policy conversation. That kind of debate can reshape how income portfolios work, since what you keep after tax matters as much as what you earn before it. This article unpacks the fiscal story and then walks through 3 dividend stocks from the screener that appear closely exposed to this shift. items.title: A 70-Year-Old With $500,000 Can Get Paid Every Month by These 4 Dividend Stocks
items.summary: When the paychecks stop but the bills keep landing monthly, a retiree needs income that arrives on the same schedule. Four monthly payers promise to cover it, yet one shared weakness could hit them all at once.

items.title: 10-Year TIPS Pay 2.77% Above Inflation. Here’s How Dividend Stocks Compare
